Regular-session close on Thursday, November 12, 2026, 4:00 p.m. New York time. Stock prices: Yahoo Finance, cross-checked against the closing price on Nasdaq.com. Volume and 30-day average volume: Nasdaq.com. 52-week range: Yahoo Finance daily highs and lows since November 13, 2025. Indices: Yahoo Finance daily closes for the same date. Follow TSM's latest price on our TSMC (TSM) stock price today page. TSM opened at $394.62, close to its day low of $393.91, and climbed as high as $411.77 during the session. It finished $11.58 above the day's low but below the day's high. Trading was lighter than usual, with 11.4 million shares changing hands, 15.93% below the average of 13.5 million shares. The stock fell further than the broad market. The Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.39% to 25,366.09, the S&P 500 eased 0.35% to 7,592.40 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 0.36% to 52,297.09, leaving TSM 1.51 percentage points behind the Nasdaq. Chip stocks moved in both directions. Nvidia (NVDA) fell 4.34%, ASML dropped 2.43% and Intel slipped 2.08%, while AMD rose 5.86% and Broadcom gained 5.54%. At the close, TSM stood 16.82% below its 52-week high of $487.47 and 51.97% above its 52-week low of $266.82. According to NVIDIA's announcement on November 12, Jensen Huang resigned as president, chief executive officer and a member of the board, effective immediately. Chief financial officer Colette Kress agreed to serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor, and Nvidia shares closed down 4.34% that day. Financial media tied TSMC's decline to the Nvidia news. As reported by GuruFocus, the shares fell in early trading as Huang's departure hit the AI chip supply chain, two days after TSMC reported its biggest month ever. Per TSMC's October 2026 revenue report, released on November 10, October revenue was approximately NT$586.89 billion, up 14.7% from September and 59.7% from October 2025. Revenue for January through October totaled NT$4,485.62 billion, up 43.3% from the same period in 2025. GuruFocus pointed to TSMC's November sales report, which it expects in early December (an estimate, not a confirmed date), as the next data point for the stock.
